text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 102 Bellefair Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where on-street permit parking is authorized on the same side of the street and the installation of a permanent ramp will result in a loss of two permit parking spaces. Additionally the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where the minimum tree clearance cannot be met and where the neighbourhood poll was negative. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Denied the request for front yard parking at 102 Bellefair Avenue.
